quest.title: Break the Sword Cemetery Seal
quest.description: According to Dr. Livingstone, there are three hilichurl tribes surrounding the Sword Cemetery in <color=#00E1FFFF>Dadaupa Gorge</color>. To the north, the Meaty tribe; to the south, the Sleeper tribe; and in the valley to the east, the Eclipse tribe. The key to breaking the seals on the Sword Cemetery may lie within their encampments...

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: What should we do... Although we worked out how to <color=#00E1FFFF>break the seal barrier</color>, with so many monsters around...

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: Hmm? Excuse me, I was lost in thought. I am Livingstone, a career adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: You! Amidst the valley flooded by monsters, I never thought I'd encounter another living being that's not a monster!

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: You must be one of my peers, a great pioneering adventurer!

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: With the mysterious stars above and the brooding abyss below, this is what our adventurous souls are made of!

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: An ancient battlefield protected by <color=#00E1FFFF>triple seal barriers</color>, which were set up by the survivors using elemental powers, to let their fallen comrades — their graves marked with swords — rest undisturbed.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: Sorry, I was lost in thought. Where were we?

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: Well, these swords... and the <color=#00E1FFFF>treasures</color> among them were the relics of the warriors who fought and died here. How could anyone let <color=#00E1FFFF>three hilichurl camps</color> come rummaging and disturb their sleep?

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: We're not hilichurls, so you can't say that what I'm doing is disturbing their sleep. We are adventurers who use their wits to conquer all mysteries and secrets!

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: I understand where you are coming from, but the <color=#00E1FFFF>seal</color>...

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: What should we do...

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: Based on the flow of elemental forces, I, the great Livingstone, have successfully worked out the location of the seal which keeps the barriers intact!

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: The <color=#00E1FFFF>three seal barriers</color> correspond to <color=#00E1FFFF>three Elemental Monuments</color> located in <color=#00E1FFFF>three nearby hilichurl camps</color>.

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: The <color=#00E1FFFF>northern</color> hilichurl camp matches the records of the "Meaty Tribe" found in the works of the great scholar Allan. They basically are a tribal race that loves nothing more than thick muscles and thick meat. They, unlike us, do not have the spirit to seek wisdom!

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: The Elemental Monument is located in the "Meaty Tribe" <color=#00E1FFFF>arena</color>. I snuck into their camp to activate it without realizing that stepping into the arena meant challenging them. Next thing I knew — hilichurls everywhere...

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: *whimpers*

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: If we can teach them a lesson in fighting, we might have a chance at breaking the seal...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Some other mechanism...

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: The other Elemental Monument is located in the <color=#00E1FFFF>southern</color> camp of the "Sleepy Tribe." They are hilichurls that <color=#00E1FFFF>sleep like logs when night falls</color>. Once again, they lack our hardworking spirit that never sleeps!

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: The Elemental Monument is located in the <color=#00E1FFFF>pool</color> in the camp. When I sneaked in under cover of darkness, there was a huge hilichurl with a shield...

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Head east and climb up the hill</color>, and you will find the camp of the Eclipse tribe. According to the records, they are rigid followers of Shamanic traditions. They do not have our adventurous, mold-breaking spirit!

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: The Elemental Monument is at the <color=#00E1FFFF>center of the camp</color>. But the Elemental Monument is surrounded by Eclipse tribe samachurls, and Abyss Mages can also be found alongside them...

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: I, Livingstone, the adventurer bearing the wisdom that could match the stars and the courage to embrace all ruins, lacks only the brute force to triumph over them!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: A shame...

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: You feel sorry for me too, don't you?

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: But wrong! In the dictionary of adventurers, there is no such phrase as "feeling sorry"!

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: Only the phrase "not enough effort!" We must exert our utmost efforts to not leave any regrets! The stars and the abyss are waiting for us, young adventurer!

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: A pity that there are things that can never be achieved even for a person who bears the Livingstone name...

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: Clear out <color=#00E1FFFF>the three hilichurl camps and activate the three seal Elemental Monuments</color>... You can't achieve such things without brute force no matter how adventurous you are!

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: Oh! I am dying, so very dying to see what <color=#00E1FFFF>treasures</color> lie behind the seal barriers!

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: If you are a true adventurer and believe you have the wisdom and courage to match anyone, then take up the challenge!

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: But my fellow adventurer, take good care of yourself!

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: Do not let excitement and adventure pass you by — not when there are still infinite mysteries in our world to behold!

talks.objective: Obtain the treasure at the center of the Sword Cemetery
Obtain the treasure at the center of the Sword Cemetery

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: Now, how should we break those seals...
